en: The front of the postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of an ornate building with large arched windows, decorative facades, and a grand central entrance. There is a stone fountain with reliefs in the foreground, flanked by stairs and manicured gardens. The text 'Bad Pyrmont, Kurhaus.' appears in the upper left corner. The back of the postcard contains German printed greetings for Christmas and the New Year, addresses and sender information, a museum stamp, and publisher information dated 1910.
